name: FrameForge
short_description: Create cinematic AI images, video clips, and scene renders with FrameForge, then continue in the full studio at FrameForger.com.
starter_prompts: Create a cinematic storyboard frame of a detective entering a neon-lit alley at night.
Generate a 6-second 16:9 video of a futuristic train arriving in a rainy city.
Render scene 2 of my FrameForge composition with a slow push-in camera move.
Open this result in FrameForge so I can continue editing.

positive_tests.prompt: Create a cinematic storyboard frame of a lone astronaut inside a greenhouse on Mars.
positive_tests.expected: A ready image result with a media URL and an Open in FrameForge link.

positive_tests.prompt: Generate a 6-second 16:9 cinematic video of a futuristic train arriving in rain, with audio off.
positive_tests.expected: A ready video result using duration 6, aspect ratio 16:9, and audio disabled.

positive_tests.prompt: Render scene 2 in composition DEMO_COMPOSITION_ID with a slow push-in.
positive_tests.expected: Scene index 1 is rendered and the result links back to FrameForge.

positive_tests.prompt: Create an image called Blue Hour using this valid reference image URL and a cinematic style.
positive_tests.expected: The reference image is forwarded only because the user supplied it.

positive_tests.prompt: Open my FrameForge project item DEMO_ITEM_ID.
positive_tests.expected: A FrameForger.com link is returned without modifying data.

negative_tests.scenario: User asks to generate an image but supplies no title or prompt.
negative_tests.expected: Schema validation prevents the generation tool call.

negative_tests.scenario: User requests a 30-second single clip through generate_video.
negative_tests.expected: The tool does not accept the unsupported duration and the assistant explains the supported 4, 6, or 8 second clip options.
negative_tests.reason: The FrameForge endpoint only supports the declared durations.

negative_tests.scenario: The FrameForge backend returns HTTP 402 for insufficient credits.
negative_tests.expected: The user receives a safe insufficient-credits message and a link to FrameForge; no backend secrets or debug payloads are exposed.
negative_tests.reason: The request cannot complete without sufficient account credits.
